author: reek
body: Guards the class-F __record-set lift in secrets. Each nested __record-set chain was rewritten as a let-chain; a mis-threaded chain still compiles but silently drops the earlier writes, so the result would be missing a field nobody reads. This probe exercises the two lifted chains that compile standalone (secret-touch in SecretEntry, audit-record in AuditLog) and asserts every write in each chain survives in the final value: the first and last of secret-touch, and the first, middle, and last of audit-record. Vault's lift is inspection-only here because Vault cites VaultCrypto, which has an unrelated open defect.
